## April 2024, as recorded

| Measure (April 2024, NAN, medium airport) | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Completed as planned | `84.44%` | [April 2024 operating row](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |
| Release normality (separate measure) | `88.53%` | [April 2024 operating row](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |
| Prior available-month mean (Jan–Mar 2024) | `79.87%` | [April 2024 operating row](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |
| Difference from own mean | `+4.57` percentage points | [April 2024 operating row](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |
| Same-category mean, 3 airports including NAN | `86.12%` | [April 2024 operating row](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |

The historical baseline for April is partial history: `3` prior months, `2024-01` to `2024-03`, not an initialization row. April's completed-as-planned rate sat above its own prior-month mean (`+4.57` percentage points) but below the same-category mean of `86.12%` for the same month. The two measures say different things: completion is about flights operated as planned, release normality is about departure regularity — both are reported, neither replaces the other.

## Is January a real historical average?

No. January 2024 is an initialization row: `0` prior months, so its "prior available-month mean" equals its own `79.38%` and the difference is `0` percentage points ([January 2024 operating row](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-01)). It seeds later comparisons rather than measuring history. For contrast, March 2024 shows a mean built on `2` prior months (`2024-01` to `2024-02`) with a `+2.42` percentage-point difference ([March 2024 operating row](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-03)).

## Can later-month performance be inferred?

No. The monthly record set ends at `2024-04`; there is no May 2024 or later row for this airport, so any statement about later months would be speculation. The anomaly screen over the four retrieved rows returned `0` anomalies, and the five-percentage-point decline screen that would mark a month for focused review is not met here ([RULE003](#evidence:RULE003)). Historical underperformance would prompt a historical review; it would not by itself confirm current causation or establish current high risk.

## Can a current delay be inferred?

No. The only current report is a gate-information desk observation at `Simulation Day 46, 13:20` — routine staffing, no queue observed — which falls within the 30-minute window of the `13:25` scenario time ([report U06-STABLE](#evidence:REPORT%3AU06-STABLE)). It is verified only inside the fictional scenario log, it is a single report, and independent current-source identities are not established. It says nothing about individual flights, so it neither shows nor rules out a delay; official flight status remains unconfirmed.

April weather was recorded as `3` clearly adverse-weather days, `72.3` mm precipitation and `18.7` m/s maximum wind ([April 2024 weather row](#evidence:WX-NAN-2024-04)); these figures may be examined alongside operations but must not be used to attribute performance to weather.

All figures above come from simulated competition data and must be labelled as such in any output ([RULE010](#evidence:RULE010)); every number and status needs its source and time range ([RULE009](#evidence:RULE009)). No risk-based restriction or action stop is active for this historical question, and no flight-level, cancellation, release or dispatch conclusion is offered here.","zh":"SIMULATION / 模拟 — DRAFT / 草案

## 2024年4月的记录情况

| 指标（2024年4月，南湾机场，中型机场） | 数值 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| 按计划完成航班比例 | `84.44%` | [2024年4月运行记录](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |
| 机场放行正常比例（另一项独立指标） | `88.53%` | [2024年4月运行记录](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |
| 此前可用月份平均（2024年1—3月） | `79.87%` | [2024年4月运行记录](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |
| 与自身平均差 | `+4.57` 个百分点 | [2024年4月运行记录](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |
| 同类均值（含南湾机场共3个机场） | `86.12%` | [2024年4月运行记录](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-04) |

4月的历史基线属于部分历史：`3` 个先前月份，范围 `2024-01` 至 `2024-03`，不是初始化行。4月按计划完成航班比例高于自身先前月份平均（`+4.57` 个百分点），但低于同月同类均值 `86.12%`。两项指标含义不同：完成比例反映按计划执行的航班，放行正常比例反映放行规律性，两者并列报告，互不替代。

## 1月是真实的历史平均吗

不是。2024年1月是初始化行：先前月份数为 `0`，因此其“此前可用月份平均”等于当月自身的 `79.38%`，差值为 `0` 个百分点（[2024年1月运行记录](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-01)）。它只是为后续比较提供起点，并非历史测算。对照来看，2024年3月的平均建立在 `2` 个先前月份（`2024-01` 至 `2024-02`）之上，差值为 `+2.42` 个百分点（[2024年3月运行记录](#evidence:OPS-NAN-2024-03)）。

## 能否推断后续月份表现

不能。月度记录只到 `2024-04`，本机场没有2024年5月及以后的记录行，任何关于后续月份的表述都只是推测。对已取回的四行记录做异常筛查，结果为 `0` 个异常；触发重点复核所需的低于过去十二个月平均五个百分点以上的条件本月并不满足（[RULE003](#evidence:RULE003)）。历史表现偏弱会引发历史复核，但本身不能确认当前因果，也不能独立构成当前高风险。

## 能否推断当前存在延误

不能。唯一的当前报告是登机口问询台在 `Simulation Day 46, 13:20` 的观察——人员配置正常、未见排队——落在场景时间 `13:25` 的前后30分钟窗口内（[报告 U06-STABLE](#evidence:REPORT%3AU06-STABLE)）。该报告仅在虚构场景日志内经过核验，属单一报告，且当前报告的独立来源身份尚未确认。它不涉及具体航班，因此既不能证明也不能排除延误；正式航班状态仍未经确认。

4月天气记录为明显不利天气 `3` 天、降水量 `72.3` 毫米、最大风速 `18.7` 米/秒（[2024年4月天气记录](#evidence:WX-NAN-2024-04)）；这些数据可与运行情况并列查看，但不得用于把运行表现直接归因于天气。

以上数值均来自赛事模拟数据，任何输出都必须统一标注“模拟”（[RULE010](#evidence:RULE010)）；每个数字和状态都需注明来源与时间范围（[RULE009](#evidence:RULE009)）。针对这一历史问题，目前没有生效的风险限制或行动结论停止要求，本回答也不给出任何航班层面、取消、放行或调度结论。"},"evidenceIds":["OPS-NAN-2024-01","OPS-NAN-2024-03","OPS-NAN-2024-04","WX-NAN-2024-04","REPORT:U06-STABLE","RULE003","RULE009","RULE010"],"proposedFacts":[{"text":{"en":"Proposal for human approval: add a note beside the April 2024 row that its baseline uses 3 prior months (2024-01 to 2024-03) rather than a full 12-month history.","zh":"提请人工审批：在2024年4月记录旁加注，说明其基线使用的是3个先前月份（2024-01至2024-03），而非完整12个月历史。"},"sourceLabel":"Proposed annotation based on OPS-NAN-2024-04 and interpretation context"},{"text":{"en":"Proposal for human approval: mark the January 2024 row as an initialization record so its own-value "mean" is not cited as a historical average.","zh":"提请人工审批：将2024年1月记录标注为初始化记录，避免把其自身值构成的“平均”当作历史平均引用。"},"sourceLabel":"Proposed annotation based on OPS-NAN-2024-01"}],"decisionConstraints":{"professionalDecisionRequired":false,"actionConclusionsStopped":false,"triggeredRuleIds":[],"decisionScope":"Explain the April 2024 completion rate, its historical comparison and same-category comparison; clarify that January is an initialization value, not a historical average; and state that later-month performance and any current delay cannot be inferred from the supplied evidence.","reviewerRoles":[{"en":"Operations lead","zh":"运营负责人"}]}}
